articles.title: Targeted ads installed Candiru spyware in zero-click attacks
articles.executive_summary: Al Jazeera Media Network was targeted in a zero-click attack via malicious online advertisements that delivered Candiru spyware to devices. The attack required only rendering the malicious ads on the victim's device, posing a significant operational risk.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attack leveraged targeted online advertisements to deliver Candiru spyware to devices in a zero-click attack. The malicious ads were rendered on the victim's device, allowing the spyware to be installed without user interaction.
actionable_mitigations: Disable JavaScript in web browsers
Use an ad blocker
Implement a web application firewall (WAF) to block suspicious traffic
articles.telegram_snippet: Al Jazeera Media Network targeted in zero-click attack via malicious online ads delivering Candiru spyware. No user interaction required for successful exploitation.

articles.executive_summary: Researchers Demonstrate OpenBSD Root Exploit Chaining 37-Year-Old Shared-Memory Bug. articles.title: Attackers Tampered with AOMEI Backupper's Update Servers for Minutes to Deliver a Backdoor
articles.executive_summary: Attackers Tampered with AOMEI Backupper's Update Servers for Minutes to Deliver a Backdoor. Attackers repeatedly changed the files that AOMEI Backupper fetches from the vendor's own update servers, in windows of five to ten minutes at a time between May and July 2026, so that any copy of the Windows backup program that checked for an update during one of those windows would download and run a backdoor.
